newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-BOLAND WIN TOSS, BAT FIRST AGAINST NATAL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BOLAND WIN TOSS, BAT FIRST AGAINST NATAL.

text.p: Boland captain Adrian Kuiper won the toss and decided to bat first on the opening day of the four-day Supersport Series cricket match against Natal at Kingsmead on Thursday.
Natal - Mark Bruyns, Doug Watson, Errol Stewart, Jonty Rhodes, Dale Benkenstein (captain), Neil Johnson, Shaun Pollock, Keith Forde, Anthony Botha, Gary Gilder, Tertius Bosch.
Boland - Lloyd Ferreira, Brian Baguley, Wayne Truter, Kenny Jackson, Adrian Kuiper (captain), Billy Stelling, David Millns, Riaan Oosthuizen, Claude Henderson, Henry Williams, Marais Erasmus.
